On this page

_October 2026 \| Released to Beta and Production_

## Before you sign in [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#before-you-sign-in "Direct link to Before you sign in")

- **Do a hard reload and clear your browser cache** the first time you open Koodisi after the upgrade (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac). This loads the new version.
- **Having trouble signing in?** Contact our support representative.

## Dates and times in your timezone [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#dates-and-times-in-your-timezone "Direct link to Dates and times in your timezone")

- **Choose your timezone.** A timezone selector in your user settings sets the zone used for every date and time in Studio. The setting is remembered across sessions and devices.
- **Consistent timestamps across locations.** Dates and times now reflect your selected timezone, so teammates in different offices see the same moment in their local time.
- **Hover any time for the full detail**, for example `2026-08-05 12:36:39 IST (UTC+05:30)`.

Some timestamps will look different after the upgrade as they now reflect your selected timezone accurately.

## Updated schedule form [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#updated-schedule-form "Direct link to Updated schedule form")

- **Run schedules in your timezone.** Set the timezone a schedule runs in on the Schedule activity's **Advanced** tab. Any named timezone is supported, such as `America/New_York` or `Europe/London`. Schedules with no timezone set now run in `America/New_York` (US Eastern), not UTC.
- **Daylight saving is handled automatically.** Schedules keep their local run time when the clocks change, including the EDT to EST change on 1 November 2026. No edit or redeploy is needed.
- **Updating an existing schedule?** Copy the existing settings, delete the old Schedule activity, then add a new Schedule activity and enter the settings there.

## Run and debug workflows in Development (Beta) [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#run-and-debug-workflows-in-development-beta "Direct link to Run and debug workflows in Development (Beta)")

- **Draft execution (Beta).** Run a workflow, including its subflows, from the editor without deploying it first, and preview the draft as it runs. Build, run and refine your workflow, then deploy once it behaves as expected.
- **Workflow Debugger (Beta).** Breakpoints are listed by workflow and subflow, so you can see where execution will pause. Deploy the workflow to Development, then step through it and inspect each step's data before you move it to Production.

## Agent Studio (Beta) [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#agent-studio-beta "Direct link to Agent Studio (Beta)")

Agent Studio is a new Studio capability for building your own AI agents using the integrations you have already built and governed in Koodisi.

- **Your activities as tools.** Agents call the activities you have already built, each with its own OAuth connection, using the same connections and permissions.
- **Agents that work together.** Agents can hand work to other agents (A2A). The canvas shows how they are connected.
- **Connect external tools.** Agents connect to MCP servers, with OAuth sign-in built into the Agent Builder.

## Koodisi AI: build, deploy and test from the chat [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#koodisi-ai-build-deploy-and-test-from-the-chat "Direct link to Koodisi AI: build, deploy and test from the chat")

Koodisi AI brings workflow building, deployment and testing into one place, taking a workflow from first draft to tested deployment without leaving the chat.

- **Better workflow building, with a live preview.** Koodisi AI builds workflows more reliably, including subflows, mappings and tables. The canvas preview updates as each change lands, so you review the result while Koodisi AI works.
- **Revert changes.** Undo the changes Koodisi AI made and return the workflow to its earlier state.
- **Create alerts from the chat.** Describe what you want to monitor and Koodisi AI sets up the alert. Review a confirmation card before the alert is saved.
- **Publish, deploy and test.** Koodisi AI publishes and deploys using the same steps as the Deploy dialog, with a changelog that names every step and field that changed. Test runs resume after a deploy, and failures include buttons that take you to the problem.
- **Generate test cases.** Ask Koodisi AI to create test cases for a workflow, then open them directly from the chat.
- **Import your requirements.** Upload existing application requirements and Koodisi AI structures them for you. Save each requirement to the organization or to one application.
- **Koodisi AI sees canvas errors.** Validation errors on the canvas are passed to Koodisi AI, so it can help resolve them.
- **A redesigned panel** with a clearer transcript, question cards and composer. The panel stays closed once you close it, and works at high browser zoom.

## Alert Configuration [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#alert-configuration "Direct link to Alert Configuration")

Setting up alerts is simpler, with plain-language choices and fewer repeat notifications for the same problem.

- **Improved alert form.** A clearer form makes alerts easier to configure.
- **Create alerts through Koodisi AI chat.** Describe what you want to monitor, then review the confirmation card before saving.
- **Choose the environment for every alert.** Each alert can now watch Development, Production or both. Existing alerts default to Production and keep working as before.

We will continue to expand alerting in upcoming releases.

## Administration [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#administration "Direct link to Administration")

- **Organization-wide certificates.** Certificates can now be shared across every workspace in your organization. Your existing certificates stay scoped to their workspace; promote any of them to the organization when you need it in more than one workspace. Certificates show an expiry badge and can be sorted by expiry date.
- **Active Usage dashboard.** A new analytics dashboard shows who is actively using Koodisi. Admins open it from **Settings** \> **Organization** \> **Active Time**.
- **Bulk actions in Applications.** Select several workflows, resources or schemas and delete them in one step.

## Building and help [​](https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/\#building-and-help "Direct link to Building and help")

- **Undo and redo on the canvas.** The toolbar Undo and Redo buttons let you move between earlier and later canvas states as you refine your workflow.
- **Recursive OpenAPI schemas** now build and deploy correctly, and `$ref` references to other files are followed.
- **Searchable documentation in Help.** The Help menu and sidebar open searchable documentation at [docs.koodisi.com](https://docs.koodisi.com/). You can also raise a support ticket from Help.
